notes.title: Blockdown will become Free!
notes.content: Thank you Blockdown fans for your support.  We have decided to make the game permanently free, starting April 25th.

notes.title: Blockdown now has "Undo"
notes.content:
[img]https://prideout.net/blog/undo_system/BlockdownUndo.gif[/img]

This new release of Blockdown now has support for undo and redo.  You can even undo a move after triggering a wobbly brown tile.

Enjoy and, stay tuned for more updates in the future!

notes.title: Blockdown Launch
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40054618/1f7a6b49246182c80350c41ae3c91b4f63d9d32b.jpg[/img]

Clear your mind and prepare for a zen-like experience, because a beautiful new puzzle game is available for purchase starting today!

Where else can you exercise your 3D spatial skills while also getting a Sokoban fix?

We'll be adding more levels over time too!

Windows and macOS are both supported.

notes.title: Blockdown is landing!
notes.content:
[b]The free Blockdown Demo is available starting NOW[/b], and the full game will be available on Friday, September 17th.
